warmup: pnpm exec supabase start && pnpm exec supabase stop

supabase.cmd: pnpm exec supabase start && exec docker logs -f --since 1s supabase_db_app

web.cmd: for i in $(seq 300); do eval "$(pnpm exec supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^[A-Z_]+=')"; [ -n "$API_URL" ] && break; sleep 2; done; SUPABASE_URL="$API_URL" SUPABASE_ANON_KEY="${PUBLISHABLE_KEY:-$ANON_KEY}" exec pnpm dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3000}
